about: SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 and §2.6: the materiality thresholds, per instrument, and the cases they are calibrated on. The cases so far come from the dietary proof's simplified pipeline (each case says what was run), not yet from the twelve captured reference journeys. Built by `python -m turbotab.core.tests.materiality_cases --write`; the registry tests rebuild it and compare.
tau_0_reason: A realized movement below a tenth of the primary interval's half-width is below noise (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4, starting convention).
tau_1_reason: A realized movement of half the half-width or more is acted on (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4, starting convention).
tau_confirm_reason: A default is a Confirm when its best alternative reaches band 1 (could bias) of its instrument.
limitation_budget_reason: At most three limitation sentences per journey (dietary inference, UNDERSTANDING_LAYER's four surfaced); beyond it a supplement line with its numbers.
min_cases_reason: A proxy is calibrated, and so may say "doesn't change your numbers here", only on at least five cases and at least one case it put below noise that stayed below noise after the lock; one case, or cases that all moved the estimate, are no evidence that its band 0 is ever right (§2.5's false reassurance). Short of that it is floored at "could bias".

convention.reason: Rows changed × the leavers' largest SMD on the adjustment set (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

rows_smd.reason: Rows changed × the leavers' largest SMD on the adjustment set (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values). Lowered to 0.003697 so that no case is predicted below noise and realized above it.

convention.reason: The exposure's W1 over its SD (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

exposure_shift.reason: The exposure's W1 over its SD (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

convention.reason: |Δr| between the exposure and another predictor (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

correlation_change.reason: |Δr| between the exposure and another predictor (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

convention.reason: 1 − λ, regression dilution's attenuation (Hutcheon et al. 2010; SURFACING_POLICY §2.3).

attenuation.reason: 1 − λ, regression dilution's attenuation (Hutcheon et al. 2010; SURFACING_POLICY §2.3).

convention.reason: |rank-biserial r| of a process column over the outcome, as design counts (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

design_imbalance.reason: |rank-biserial r| of a process column over the outcome, as design counts (SURFACING_POLICY §2.4 starting values).

convention.reason: A detector's share beyond its chance share; band 2 when more than half beyond it (SURFACING_POLICY §2.5, S7).

excess_over_chance.reason: A detector's share beyond its chance share; band 2 when more than half beyond it (SURFACING_POLICY §2.5, S7).

convention.reason: An alternative that changes what the estimate is: always act on it, never graded by a number.

changes_question.reason: An alternative that changes what the estimate is: always act on it, never graded by a number.

invariance.reason: Exact by theorem, not a proxy (SURFACING_POLICY §2.6 as amended; WAVE_C6A_PLAN §7 ruling 2): an alternative that leaves the model matrix's column space unchanged (a two-valued column that is not focal coded the other way round, or adjustment terms written another way) leaves the focal coefficient, its standard error and the fitted values exactly where they are, because the focal coefficient depends on the other columns only through the space they span (Frisch & Waugh 1933; Lovell 1963). Its movement is 0 by proof, so it needs no calibration cases, is never floored at band 1, and calibrate keeps this entry as it is. Its thresholds are τ₀ and τ₁, never reached.
